A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Self-Transcendence work. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and supplementary sections are readable and matchable despite substantial reformatting and relocation.

before.justification: v2 reports original generation results, ablations, training-cost measurements, and supplementary ImageNet 512×512 and text-to-image experiments.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results and adds layer-wise ImageNet linear-probing results in Section 4.5 and Table 7.

M1.justification: Equation 3 corrects the written guidance calculation from fg = fu + ω·fc − fu to fg = fu + ω·(fc − fu). This revises the mathematical specification of a core component, while the two-stage pipeline remains unchanged. It appears to repair the already-described CFG operation; an implementation change is not established.

E1.justification: v3 adds explicit ImageNet linear probing, but v2 Figure 2 already reports logistic-regression accuracies. The classification datasets and class sets are insufficiently specified to establish whether this expands coverage or only extends the probing protocol. ImageNet generation and text-to-image coverage are retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the matched generation, ablation, and supplementary comparisons. The added linear probe reuses vanilla SiT-XL/2 and REPA, already jointly compared with Self-Transcendence, without introducing a new comparison method.

E3.justification: Section 4.5 adds linear probing at t = 0.5 using features from layers 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, and 24. Existing generation settings, evaluation sample counts, training budgets, and early-stopping procedures remain unchanged. Probe training and data-split details are not supplied.

E4.justification: The new layer-wise probe quantitatively examines discriminative representations across model depth, complementing the existing t-SNE, logistic-regression, and PCA evidence. Earlier component ablations, hyperparameter studies, one-stage comparisons, and early-stopping analyses are retained.

E5.justification: The new Table 7 provides point scores without additional run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests. Existing statistical-reporting practices and same-seed qualitative comparisons are unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 7 adds classification scores across six layers. At layer 12, vanilla SiT, REPA, and Self-Transcendence score 16.25%, 52.07%, and 49.13%, respectively; at layer 16, Self-Transcendence slightly exceeds REPA, 50.00% versus 49.76%. Matched generation, ablation, and cost results are unchanged.

T1.justification: Equation 3 receives a mathematically substantive grouping correction: v2's expression cancels the unconditional feature, whereas v3 scales the conditional–unconditional difference, consistent with Equation 2. No new theorem, proof, or derivation is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: self-contained two-stage guidance and competitive or superior generation and convergence relative to REPA. The added probing evidence does not redefine these central claims.

C2.justification: Section 4.5 newly acknowledges generally lower linear separability than REPA despite stronger generation results, attributing this to better alignment between teacher and student diffusion settings. Existing limitations concerning model capacity, hyperparameter tuning, and untested generative modalities remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 adds a project-page link and advertises models alongside code, whereas v2 advertises source code only. Existing MLP architecture, hyperparameter, hardware, and training-time disclosures are retained.

R1.justification: The cited works and positioning relative to REPA, SRA, LayerSync, and other prior methods are retained. Reference reordering and bibliographic formatting corrections do not introduce new research positioning.

P1.justification: Most prose is retained. v3 moves the text-to-image experiment into Section 4.2, reorganizes supplementary sections as Appendices A–E after the references, and adds Section 4.5. Other edits include author-contribution information, keywords, and limited wording corrections.

P2.justification: v3 redesigns the document throughout with institutional headers and footers, different typography, margins, heading styles, and front matter. Retained figures and tables are extensively resized and repositioned, including moving text-to-image displays into the main text. Table 7 is new; the original scientific figure images are retained.

improvement.justification: Correcting Equation 3 resolves an inconsistency in the reproducible method specification. The added layer-wise probe provides useful evidence about representation quality and qualifies its relationship to generation performance, while retaining earlier results. The improvement is limited because the probing protocol remains underspecified and the proposed mechanism is not directly tested.
